purpose: PocketD-D block 4: device interior environments and shared pixel icons

generation.request_summary: Production 2x2 atlas matching approved camp HD-2D pixel art. Outfitter workshop, magical library, cozy inn bedroom, cartographer sanctuary; empty dark centers for real UI, no people, text or UI buttons. Deep teal/blue shadows, warm lamps and crisp pixel clusters.

Transparent 4x3 atlas matching approved RPG icons. Heart/shield/crystal/hourglass; gear/USB plug/potion/crate; adventurer/sun/quill/check token. Single complete icons with dark outlines, jewel colors, no labels or panels.

export: build_assets.py samples backgrounds on 233x233 grid then replicates exactly to 466x466. Icon alpha threshold 50%, explicit occupied-row slices, trim and shared output grid. C raster data is versioned; no ImageMagick runtime/build dependency.
limits: Artwork is decorative and does not infer equipment, character rules or additional device features.
